name: grep_clean
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import re
s=open("inputs/sources/bunkbed.clean.txt",encoding="utf-8").read()
print(len(s))
print(s[:2500])
for pat in ["E7","Model 4.5","Definition 1.4","Conjecture 6.4","Theorem 1.2"]:
    print("#"*12,pat)
    for m in list(re.finditer(pat,s))[:4]:
        a=max(0,m.start()-300); b=min(len(s),m.end()+400)
        print("...",s[a:b].replace("\n"," "))
        print("-"*40)
